scope: Frozen 3–11 October development validation; no controls or V34 loss used.
observation_scope: Onboard queries condition only the first leg departure/arrival and receipts available at that arrival. The target realization is used only for scoring.
score_scope: CRPS, intervals and Brier use the operating-clock law. Cancellation mass is separate. Brier is P(next arrival<=scheduled arrival+300 | operating,current public history).

gate.scope: Development model-retention rule only; not G2 or independent confirmation.

descriptive.scope: Descriptive target-has-forecast stratum of saved onboard rows; no new model or gate.
descriptive.interpretation: The overall macro coverage can move farther above 90% while the forecast-present subset moves upward toward 90% from below. The frozen overall gate remains unchanged; neither a formal gate failure nor this descriptive subset proves uniform deterioration or successful joint calibration. Query exposures are clustered within trips and dates.
